title: Epstein's obsession with gravity, propulsion and physicists
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Epstein's obsession with gravity, propulsion and physicists, about 1990s-2019 at Little St. James Island, US Virgin Islands, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Little St. James Island, US Virgin Islands

tellings.quote:

He would fly physicists out to his

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the financier Jeffrey Epstein was obsessed with secret science, especially gravity and ways of moving craft. According to Michels, Epstein flew well-known physicists such as Kip Thorne, Stephen Hawking and Murray Gell-Mann out to his private island in the US Virgin Islands, and gave the physicist Lawrence Krauss about $250,000. He tells it as a lesser-known thread that, if true, ties Epstein to hidden research into advanced propulsion.
